title: Celty: SpMSpV GPU Kernel and SIMT Co-Design for Efficient Dual-Sparse LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.01536v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on sparsity to cut inference cost, but most prior work exploits a single sparsity source and targets batched multi-user inference. Dual-sparsity, which pairs unstructured weight pruning with runtime activation sparsity, offers a compelling size-accuracy-latency tradeoff for single-user decoding, but forms a Sparse Matrix-Sparse Vector (SpMSpV) workload that existing GPU kernels handle poorly. We propose Celty, a co-designed sparse format, GPU kernel, and SIMT microarchitecture for SpMSpV in LLM inference. Celty's Run-Length Compressed CSC (RLC-CSC) format enables vectorized loading of compressed weight columns and exploits both sparsity sources to skip memory accesses, accumulating partial products in shared memory. translated_title: Celty：面向高效双稀疏大语言模型推理的SpMSpV GPU内核与SIMT协同设计
translated_abstract: 大语言模型日益依赖稀疏性来降低推理成本，但以往大多数工作仅利用单一稀疏来源，且面向批量多用户推理场景。双稀疏性将非结构化权重剪枝与运行时激活稀疏性相结合，为单用户解码提供了极具吸引力的模型尺寸-精度-延迟权衡，但其形成了稀疏矩阵-稀疏向量工作负载，而现有GPU内核对此处理不佳。我们提出了Celty，这是一个针对LLM推理中SpMSpV运算协同设计的稀疏格式、GPU内核和SIMT微架构。Celty的游程压缩CSC（RLC-CSC）格式支持对压缩权重列的向量化加载，并利用两种稀疏来源跳过内存访问，在共享内存中累积部分乘积。Celty稀疏SIMT核心随后增加了流水线式RLC解码器，消除了软件索引重建的开销，并将本地寄存器文件重新用于无冲突的累加计算。
tldr: 提出Celty——一个协同设计的稀疏格式、GPU内核和SIMT微架构，通过游程压缩CSC格式与流水线RLC解码器高效处理双稀疏工作负载，实现单用户解码场景下高效的大语言模型SpMSpV推理。
